import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import lightgbm as lgb
import math
import os
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)

# Define bounding box for NYC to filter invalid coordinates
NYC_BOUNDS = {
    "pickup_latitude": (40.5, 41.0),
    "pickup_longitude": (-74.5, -73.5),
    "dropoff_latitude": (40.5, 41.0),
    "dropoff_longitude": (-74.5, -73.5),
}


def haversine(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    R = 6371  # Earth radius in km
    phi1, phi2 = np.radians(lat1), np.radians(lat2)
    dphi = np.radians(lat2 - lat1)
    dlambda = np.radians(lon2 - lon1)
    a = np.sin(dphi / 2) ** 2 + np.cos(phi1) * np.cos(phi2) * np.sin(dlambda / 2) ** 2
    return 2 * R * np.arcsin(np.sqrt(a))


def manhattan(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    return np.abs(lat1 - lat2) + np.abs(lon1 - lon2)


# Load training data with smaller subset for speed
train = pd.read_csv("./input/labels.csv", nrows=100000)

# Clean training data: stricter filtering based on data overview
train = train[(train["fare_amount"] > 0) & (train["fare_amount"] <= 100)]
train = train[(train["passenger_count"] >= 0) & (train["passenger_count"] <= 6)]
# Filter based on reasonable bounds for NYC area (using test data ranges as hint)
train = train[(train["pickup_latitude"] >= 40.5) & (train["pickup_latitude"] <= 41.0)]
train = train[
    (train["pickup_longitude"] >= -74.5) & (train["pickup_longitude"] <= -73.5)
]
train = train[(train["dropoff_latitude"] >= 40.5) & (train["dropoff_latitude"] <= 41.0)]
train = train[
    (train["dropoff_longitude"] >= -74.5) & (train["dropoff_longitude"] <= -73.5)
]

# Parse datetime
train["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(train["pickup_datetime"], errors="coerce")
train = train.dropna(subset=["pickup_datetime"])

# Feature engineering
train["pickup_hour"] = train["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
train["pickup_dayofweek"] = train["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
train["pickup_day"] = train["pickup_datetime"].dt.day
train["pickup_month"] = train["pickup_datetime"].dt.month

train["dist_haversine"] = haversine(
    train["pickup_latitude"],
    train["pickup_longitude"],
    train["dropoff_latitude"],
    train["dropoff_longitude"],
)
train["dist_manhattan"] = manhattan(
    train["pickup_latitude"],
    train["pickup_longitude"],
    train["dropoff_latitude"],
    train["dropoff_longitude"],
)

# Features for training
feature_cols = [
    "passenger_count",
    "pickup_hour",
    "pickup_dayofweek",
    "pickup_day",
    "pickup_month",
    "pickup_latitude",
    "pickup_longitude",
    "dropoff_latitude",
    "dropoff_longitude",
    "dist_haversine",
    "dist_manhattan",
]

X = train[feature_cols].values
y = train["fare_amount"].values

# Train/validation split
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.1, random_state=42)

# LightGBM model with reduced complexity for faster training
lgb_train = lgb.Dataset(X_train, y_train)
lgb_val = lgb.Dataset(X_val, y_val, reference=lgb_train)

params = {
    "objective": "regression",
    "metric": "rmse",
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "num_leaves": 15,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
}

model = lgb.train(
    params,
    lgb_train,
    num_boost_round=100,
    valid_sets=[lgb_train, lgb_val],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=10), lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)],
)

# Compute validation RMSE
val_preds = model.predict(X_val)
val_rmse = math.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_val, val_preds))
print(f"Validation RMSE: {val_rmse:.4f}")

# Prepare and save test predictions
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
test["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(test["pickup_datetime"], errors="coerce")
test = test.dropna(subset=["pickup_datetime"])

# Feature engineering on test data
test["pickup_hour"] = test["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
test["pickup_dayofweek"] = test["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
test["pickup_day"] = test["pickup_datetime"].dt.day
test["pickup_month"] = test["pickup_datetime"].dt.month

test["dist_haversine"] = haversine(
    test["pickup_latitude"],
    test["pickup_longitude"],
    test["dropoff_latitude"],
    test["dropoff_longitude"],
)
test["dist_manhattan"] = manhattan(
    test["pickup_latitude"],
    test["pickup_longitude"],
    test["dropoff_latitude"],
    test["dropoff_longitude"],
)

test_X = test[feature_cols].values
test_preds = model.predict(test_X)

# Create submission file matching sample_submission.csv format
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")
submission = pd.DataFrame({"key": sample_sub["key"], "fare_amount": test_preds})
submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
